# Copilot code review instructions

This repository is a sample AWS IAM security review for Harbor Goods, a fictional company.

- `data/synthetic/before/` is insecure on purpose. Do not suggest fixing it; fixes live in `remediation/`.
- Only AWS documentation example account IDs may appear: `111122223333`, `999988887777`, `444455556666`. Flag any
  other 12-digit account ID, real ARN, email, IP address or secret.
- `evidence/` is generated by `make evidence`; flag hand edits and evidence changes without a matching report update.
- Flag suppressed lint rules and blanket scanner skips; Checkov skips need a reason next to the resource.
- `scripts/` must stay Python standard library only, with no network or AWS calls. Shell scripts must pass
  shellcheck and shellharden with every variable quoted.
- Workflows: `permissions: {}` at the top, per-job grants, actions pinned by full SHA, `timeout-minutes` on every job,
  no `pull_request_target`, no AWS credentials or `id-token` in pull request jobs.
- Pull request titles follow Conventional Commits.
